summary.overview: In the recent M&A and Business Development catch-up meeting, team members reviewed key activities including the integration of Fireflies for CRM data entry, where Shabs Shams will update fields such as revenue and seller status. Ahmed Zia highlighted a planned email campaign to reach 13.2K qualified recipients, targeting the retail media trend for new business opportunities, with Andy Day approving the design. Additionally, the team discussed lead generation strategies, with Ahmed tasked to establish a new campaign focused on AI, martech, and retail sectors, while also managing lead purchases. Financial updates showed lower EBITDA for Prospect Direct, prompting a reevaluation of their valuation. A roll-up strategy for agency acquisitions was also examined. Action items were assigned, including creating a Loom video on updating listings and scheduling a follow-up meeting with Prospect Direct.
summary.short_summary: In the recent M&A and Business Development catch-up, team members reviewed several key activities. Shabs Shams will update CRM fields, including revenue and seller status, using Fireflies for data entry. The team also discussed lead generation strategies, with Ahmed tasked to set up a new campaign centered on AI, martech, and retail sectors. Financial updates revealed a lower EBITDA for Prospect Direct, prompting a reassessment of their valuation. A roll-up strategy for agency acquisitions was also explored, and action items included creating a Loom video for listing updates and scheduling a follow-up meeting with Prospect Direct.
